title: Canada › Canoe › Film In
intro: The film in (story/films/snowman.ts): the snowy park under the castle hotel, flags and lanterns, nobody about.

flags.text: That's Lulu! Her baby swam away.
No baby, no song! Let's go find it!
flags.was: She lives by the glacier. Let's paddle!

script.text: Every big game starts with a song.
script.when: The film in (story/films/canoe.ts): the dock on the turquoise lake, Maple in the red canoe.
A loon calls, far across the water, and the mountains answer (a beat with no line). Then Lulu herself by the glacier, looking all round: her chick has paddled off.
